item.title: Tampon Metals and the Vaginal Microbiome: The Blind Spot in the Risk Assessment
item.description: A 2026 FDA risk assessment by Jin et al. calls the metals in tampons safe, but only for one endpoint: the fraction absorbed systemically into the blood. That verdict rests on a single word, bioavailable. The vaginal microbes live on the surface, not in the bloodstream, and were never assessed.
